item.tib: dbal gsas gsang sgrub kyi tshe sgrub tshe lung yang thig
item.coloph: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi nang nas/ g.yung drung tshe lung dngos grub kyi sgrub pa/ tshe thung lo brgyar bsring ba'i rgyun thag dus min 'chi ba gso ba'i sman mchog mi tshe mthar phyin pa'i tshe sgrub/ bder gshegs rig 'dzin yongs kyi thugs bcud/ bla chen dran pa nam mkha'i lung don/ stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyi snyan rgyud/ dus mtha'i rnal 'byor bdag gi dngos grub/ ma 'ongs sgrub pa po yi spyod yul zhes bya ba mang+ga lam/ dge des 'gro kun 'chi med skyes nas btsan pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
